gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve the list of dynamic modules registered in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can verify their status and configuration.
gold.ideal: The response should include a JSON array of dynamic modules with their respective details such as id, name, and status.

gold.user: As an administrator, I want to register new dynamic modules in the Jira Cloud platform to enhance the functionality of my application.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the successful registration of the module with its unique identifier and any relevant metadata.

gold.user: As a system maintainer, I want to remove specific dynamic modules from the Jira Cloud platform to clean up unused resources and improve performance.
gold.ideal: The response should indicate the successful removal of the module and any relevant status messages.
